change_kind: Release-scope and evidence synchronization; no conceptual requirement deletion or lowered MUST priority

original_definition.title: Content scope
original_definition.requirement: Represent risk content, context and evidence without prescribing a management process.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Map information without inferring process compliance.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring a complete process or certification from stored content.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Meaning and standards alignment remain independent review; storage of content does not establish process compliance.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Risk-knowledge representation only; no process compliance or improved decisions.

original_definition.title: Case continuity
original_definition.requirement: Keep a case distinct from register entries, scenarios, scores and occurrences.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Two entries and two scenarios can concern one case without identity collapse.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Merging cases solely because labels or scores match.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Independent case/scenario identity decisions and real reassessment examples remain unaccepted.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Synthetic keys/links and withheld candidates do not independently validate real case identity.

original_definition.title: Document identity and history
original_definition.requirement: Separate artifact, issued version and expressed content; preserve issued payloads.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Retrieve a superseded issued version without overwriting it.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Historical retrieval silently reads current mutable values.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: No database/application proof of issued-payload immutability or historical retrieval. Supplementary correction metadata does not add native lineage semantics.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Current selected SQLite preservation is executed; full private relational correspondence and InformationContent admission are not claimed.

original_definition.title: Assessment context
original_definition.requirement: Retain method, scale, dimension, basis, context and time with results.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Equal scores on incompatible versions remain distinguishable.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Treating missing context as zero or equal values as comparability.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Full context/time/method joins, scale compatibility and numerical comparison are not established by retrieving linked values.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Metadata-based selected comparison only, no general assessment readiness or calculations.

original_definition.title: Reported and computed scores
original_definition.requirement: Distinguish supplied scores from calculations with justified pinned inputs.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Retain an unverified reported score; reject a claimed computation with missing required inputs.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Presenting supplied arithmetic as a verified calculation.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Conditional reported/computed readiness and justified arithmetic under C-21 have no complete acceptance run.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Original MUST priority is preserved. The first final release may claim conceptual distinction/reported content only; excluding current computation readiness/arithmetic is an explicit owner scope decision.

original_definition.title: Source-qualified assertions
original_definition.requirement: Preserve source content, locator, interpretation origin, corrections and conflicting assertions.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: A proposed mapping preserves its source assertion and does not create an occurrence.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Overwriting evidence or treating a correction as independent corroboration.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Source locator, interpretation and correction lineage use supplementary envelope fields; independent extraction and source/corroboration judgments remain pending.

accepted_release_scope.limit: CQ06: 13 source statements; CQ07: five source cell pairs; CQ08: 11 prior withheld candidates. Not whole extraction accuracy or independent semantic review.

original_definition.title: Evidence-qualified responsibility
original_definition.requirement: Keep assignment information separate from an asserted mandate; ground actual relators with distinct participants.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Retain an assignment record without fabricating an actor or actual mandate.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring Risk Owner or a second actor from documentation alone.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Actual mandate grounding, ownership, responsibility identity and authority require independent/application review.

accepted_release_scope.limit: No actual mandate/authority/ownership grounding or universal deduplication capability.

original_definition.title: Time and workflow
original_definition.requirement: Separate recorded, reference and validity time and scheme-qualified workflow interpretation.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: A closed entry does not establish cessation; an absent rule stays unknown.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Inferring treatment effectiveness or cessation from a state label.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Synthetic state codes and asserted-link retrieval do not validate time intervals, transition authority, cessation or treatment effectiveness.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Original MUST retained; full interval/transition/cessation/effectiveness tasks excluded from proposed current executable scope.

original_definition.title: External boundaries and modes
original_definition.requirement: Keep heterogeneous referents optional; vulnerability requires one justified object bearer.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: The typed projection excludes untyped boundary notions and preserves bearer dependence.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Treating a description as an actual vulnerability or an untyped boundary as a typed core class.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: External-reference resolution, substantial-bearer grounding and domain meaning remain independent decisions.

accepted_release_scope.limit: No automatic external referent existence or real-world mode/bearer grounding.

original_definition.title: Policies and thresholds
original_definition.requirement: Preserve source-qualified appetite/tolerance meanings and a compatible indicator or scale anchor.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: A scale-only threshold can be represented without inventing an indicator.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Collapsing different source meanings or inventing required evidence.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: C-08 unit/scale compatibility is PARTIAL; source-framework appetite/tolerance interpretation remains pending.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Metadata threshold compatibility and scheme keys only; no full normative equivalence, arithmetic or conversion.

original_definition.title: Projection and admission
original_definition.requirement: Account for model elements and distinguish raw, managed and task-ready data.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: An incomplete record remains available without a false readiness declaration.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Confusing data completeness, mapping allocation and semantic adequacy.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: CatalogInspection is the sole executed admission task. Full risk-record, conditional and task readiness remain open; raw candidates are not managed OWL scenarios.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Only the named executed profiles are proposed supported. Generic risk-record/conditional readiness is not an accepted executable capability.

original_definition.title: Quality evidence and reuse
original_definition.requirement: Bind claims to the exact model, evidence population, method and limits.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Every published result identifies its input version and scope.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Inheriting a result from a different version or treating counts as semantic validity.
original_definition.status: Design requirement; formal and independent adequacy assessment pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: No overall semantic-quality score or independent acceptance follows from traceability or engineering pass counts.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Inspectable method/version/population evidence; no overall semantic correctness percentage.

original_definition.title: Risk knowledge scope
original_definition.requirement: The ontology shall represent risk-related content and context without prescribing the risk-management process.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Given a process description, only relevant information content is mapped; process-compliance claims are absent.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: A RACI design or complete process lifecycle is inferred as mandatory ontology scope.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Independent interpretation of real process descriptions remains #7/#13; no compliance claim follows.

accepted_release_scope.limit: No standards/process compliance.

original_definition.title: Case continuity
original_definition.requirement: A RiskCase shall remain distinct from records, pattern specifications, scores and actual occurrences.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: A reassessment links to the same case while preserving separate result identity.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Equal text or scores automatically merge cases or create occurrences.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Synthetic case links and score/version joins are separate examples; real reassessment continuity remains #7/#13.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Real case grounding remains attributable; no equal-label merge.

original_definition.title: Source-qualified policy statements
original_definition.requirement: Appetite and tolerance shall be stored as versioned statements with source meaning and context.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Permissible-deviation and willingness-to-bear statements remain distinguishable.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Equal labels create equivalentClass or exactMatch assertions.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Source-qualified appetite/tolerance meanings and framework/version comparison remain #8.

accepted_release_scope.limit: No global appetite/tolerance equivalence or normative full-source interpretation.

original_definition.title: Boundary-aware standards review
original_definition.requirement: The review shall record edition, inspected portions, semantic difference and access limitations.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: The report identifies accessible clauses and leaves uninspected scope unassessed.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: Absence of inspected conflict is reported as full compliance.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Edition/clause-qualified inspection, divergence and access-limit corpus is incomplete; current reference links are not a complete review.

accepted_release_scope.limit: The 11-source, 13-interpretation inspected-portion register exists; not a full normative crosswalk or systematic review.

original_definition.title: Complete inventory disposition
original_definition.requirement: Every inherited concept, association and generalization shall have a retained, revised or removed disposition.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: All prior IDs reconcile to the current registers or a reasoned removal ledger.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: A prior item disappears silently or an unresolved stereotype is fabricated.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: All retained public model and requirement identities are reconciled. Restricted pre-public acquisition identities are outside this export and are not claimed reconciled.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Retained public IDs are reconciled; restricted pre-public acquisition identities are excluded from this public-export claim.

original_definition.title: Temporal statement interpretation
original_definition.requirement: Issued information, reference time and administrative state shall remain distinguishable.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Closure alone cannot satisfy a test for cessation or treatment effectiveness.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: A closed entry is interpreted as a ceased risk.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: No historical immutable-store or full temporal/workflow acceptance run; observed absence is not a universal negation.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Selected SQLite history now executed; complete time/workflow semantics not claimed.

original_definition.title: Threshold interpretation
original_definition.requirement: Thresholds shall declare an indicator or scale anchor and compatible interpretation.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: Indicator-based and scale-only boundaries can be represented without inventing an indicator.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: A scale-only threshold is rejected solely because a nonexistent indicator was not fabricated.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Scale-only anchor has prior bounded evidence; dual-anchor unit/scale compatibility remains PARTIAL in #5.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Dual-anchor compatibility is metadata-scoped, global C-08 still PARTIAL.

original_definition.title: Evidence-qualified responsibility
original_definition.requirement: Recorded assignment information shall be preserved even when a real responsibility relation cannot be grounded.
original_definition.acceptance_criterion: A self-assignment source can be recorded without inventing a second actor.
original_definition.negative_acceptance_criterion: A technical relation creates authority, accountability or a second actor without evidence.
original_definition.status: Design obligation; public-export execution pending

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Synthetic assignment retrieval and prior distinct-participant controls do not establish an actual mandate or authority.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Assignment information may exist without actual grounded mandate/second actor.

original_definition.question: Which entries document the same case?
original_definition.expected_result: Two distinct entries can refer to one case.
original_definition.rejection: Entries become the case or are grouped by equal labels.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Independent real-world case identity adjudication remains #7/#13; conflicting links are retrieved, not admitted.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Synthetic exact case/entry joins plus selected SQL identity evidence; no independent real-case adjudication.

original_definition.question: Which scenarios concern a case?
original_definition.expected_result: Distinct scenario specifications link to the case.
original_definition.rejection: Scenario identity is collapsed into case identity.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Raw/managed admission and evidence that an occurrence happened are outside this retrieval test (#5/#13).

accepted_release_scope.limit: Scenario aboutness retrieval, not occurrence or admission.

original_definition.question: Can equal scores use different scale versions?
original_definition.expected_result: Both values and their different pinned scales remain retrievable.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Core OWL has no numeric scalar field. Arithmetic, method/scale compatibility and complete temporal joins remain #5/#12.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Retrieval and declared compatibility supplements are separate; no arithmetic or universal comparability.

original_definition.question: Can assignment information exist without an actual mandate?
original_definition.expected_result: The assignment is retained without an asserted real mandate.
original_definition.rejection: A relator or second actor is invented.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Grounding, actual authority, ownership and participant identity remain #7/#12; no mandate is synthesized.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Assignment records without invented mandates; no actual authority judgment.

original_definition.question: Does entry closure establish risk cessation?
original_definition.expected_result: Closure and cessation evidence are independent.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass

rows.original_remaining_obligation: State-code interpretation is a synthetic fixture policy, not standards equivalence or an OWL non-entailment proof. Temporal/cessation adjudication remains #7/#12.

accepted_release_scope.limit: Synthetic workflow labels illustrate distinction, not full temporal/workflow acceptance.

original_definition.question: Can an assertion be traced to its source?
original_definition.expected_result: Its source identity, locator and interpretation origin are recoverable.
original_definition.rejection: Missing or misjoined provenance is presented as source support.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass
original_definition.population: Evidence-preservation task; independent data preparation required

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Locator and interpretation-origin scalars are application fields, not native OWL properties. Independent literature extraction/support remains #13 and adequacy #7.

accepted_release_scope.limit: 13 inspected source statements, 35 query/control outcomes; not complete original broad population or independent extraction validation.

original_definition.question: Does correction lineage remain distinguishable?
original_definition.expected_result: A correction is linked to its corrected statement.
original_definition.rejection: The correction is counted as independent corroboration.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass
original_definition.population: Evidence-preservation task; independent data preparation required

rows.original_remaining_obligation: General correction lineage is not a native Riskium property. This explicit application record profile does not prove source independence, immutable storage or real-data acceptance (#12/#13).

accepted_release_scope.limit: Five original/reissued cell pairs and exact lineage/value/locator controls; no independent corroboration or recomputed estimates.

original_definition.question: Can unsupported case identity remain unasserted?
original_definition.expected_result: A candidate scenario can remain incomplete without a fabricated case.
original_definition.rejection: An identity is invented to satisfy a managed-record constraint.
original_definition.status: Planned for execution on the public model; no inherited pass
original_definition.population: Evidence-preservation task; independent data preparation required

rows.original_remaining_obligation: Incomplete raw candidates are not asserted to be managed OWL scenarios. Independent source-case identities and admission remain #5/#13.

accepted_release_scope.limit: All 11 already-withheld candidates queried with unbound cases; absence of graph link is not proof of real-world nonexistence.
